rounds.text: The market currently undervalues Mysore Paper Mills Ltd at a capitalization of only ₹ 88.2 Cr [E1], despite clear evidence of a significant operational turnaround. While the company faced recent headwinds, the most recent quarterly data shows a dramatic recovery with operating margins surging to 63% in June 2026, a 16 percentage point improvement over the year-ago quarter [E11]. This efficiency gain is complemented by a powerful resurgence in top-line performance, evidenced by a 40% year-over-year sales increase [E23] and strong sales growth signals [E24]. Conceded: the company has struggled with a 36% decline in trailing twelve-month sales [E5], a 10% drop in profit growth [E8], and a contraction in operating margins over the last three years [E10]. However, the 5-year compounded sales growth of 15% [E3] demonstrates the firm's underlying capacity to scale effectively when momentum is captured. By focusing on the most recent quarterly trajectory rather than trailing averages, it becomes evident that the business is currently undergoing a sharp and positive structural shift [E11, E23].
